note: Set-up: white-side-up diamond. Source: https://origami.me/santa/
1a: Precrease vertically.
1b: Precrease horizontally.
2a: Bring the lower-left edge to the center.
2b: Bring the lower-right edge to the center.
3: Precrease the upper tip onto the colored boundary; follow the double arrow showing unfolding.
4: Lower the upper flap until the previous crease meets the colored boundary.
5: Raise the front lower tip to the previous crease.
6: Raise the bottom edge of the front flap along the existing crease.
7: Halve the top flap upward.
8: Turn over.
9a: Precrease the left short edge onto the middle.
9b: Repeat on the right.
10a: Turn over.
10b: Open the left long flap.
10c: Open the right long flap.
11a: Align the upper-left outer edge with the nearest crease.
11b: Repeat on the right.
12a: Refold the left long flap on its existing hinge.
12b: Refold the right long flap on its existing hinge.
13: Fold the lower flap behind at the horizontal diagonal.
14a: Fold the left side fully behind along its precrease.
14b: Fold the right side fully behind. The source offers an optional stand; this model uses its flat finish.
